candidates.why_meaningful: A complete shared-parameter reasoning loop lets source-specific head evidence repeatedly revise node representations while original evidence remains available. This changes information processing, not only the weight of an already-pooled vector.
candidates.distinct_from_others: Only this candidate has within-readout LSTM state and shared iterative message/update parameters. It sums unrestricted learned pair messages; it is neither dense edge-state attention, feed-forward sigmoid graph convolution nor multi-statistic aggregation.
limitations: Original per-step supervision is deliberately omitted to keep the existing objective; do not claim the source convergence encouragement.
Graph diameter is <=2 through Local; five rounds are nonlinear refinement, not access to new temporal evidence.
No license found in author repo or inspected source: no code copying; future implementation must be independent from paper formulas.
The source bAbI word/question encoders, graph task head and losses are excluded; this is an architecture transfer, not paper reproduction.

candidates.why_meaningful: Relations persist and change over layers rather than disappearing after each attention sum. The block can revise Base/Gap same-head and cross-head interactions jointly with the node evidence using explicit pair states.
candidates.distinct_from_others: Only candidate with dense persistent edge embeddings co-evolving with nodes and unrestricted global attention. Edge gating is one component of a two-stream architecture, not the modification by itself.
limitations: Typed relation inputs replace molecule/task-specific encodings; no SVD positional encoding or source auxiliary structural objective is used.
Quadratic pair-state storage remains, though <=25 active nodes makes the proposed design bounded.
Pair states are learned evidence relations, not calibrated reliability or discovered physical structure.

Keep edge updates and edge FFNs in the first two layers; use the author-supported node-only final layer to avoid dead trainable edge parameters. Edge-bias-only attention in every layer would be an ablation, not this candidate.

limitations: This is the original residual gated convolution, not every later model called GatedGCN.
The unnormalized neighbor sum can change magnitude with degree; per-node LayerNorm and residual paths are fixed adaptations, not a robustness guarantee.
Using LayerNorm rather than author's BatchNorm must be reported.
The six layers do not imply six steps of causal history; all operate on one already-read evidence graph.

candidates.why_meaningful: Mean-only fusion loses disagreement and extremal evidence. PNA transports neighborhood distribution statistics and degree information through several relation-aware message-passing layers, preserving its defining twelve-channel aggregation rather than attaching a statistic to final pooling.
candidates.distinct_from_others: Only candidate without learned attention or edge gates: information selection is via multiple fixed statistics and degree scalers followed by learned message/update networks. Its mechanism is complementary to recurrent refinement and learned relation weighting.
limitations: Chosen graph degrees vary modestly (8..24); retain but do not overclaim benefits of scalers.
Min/max can emphasize outliers and std is not calibrated uncertainty.
The fixed seven-mask degree reference and per-node normalization are explicit new-task adaptations.
Author PyG source is the semantic reference; a pure-PyTorch independent implementation can avoid new dependencies. Do not blindly port dense-reference tensor reduction axes.
